title: No two buttons for one job
statement: Give each screen one forward button, and never show two buttons that do the same job.
example: A screenshot sweep flags any screen showing more than 1 filled button.
detail: Review feedback on a 3D version of the Grade 9 lessons rejected clutter and two controls doing one job, and its rules say no two controls may do the same job (`othello-archive/DESIGN.md`, line 4; `othello-archive/README.md`, line 87). Its shell keeps one filled Next in the footer as the only forward control, which no step may duplicate, with one filled button at a time (`othello-archive/BRIEF.md`, lines 12-13), and a screenshot sweep flags any screen with more than one filled button (`othello-archive/scripts/sweep.mjs`, line 69).
against: The rule bars a second button, not a second way to press the one there is: in one step a click on the stage and the keyboard do the footer button's job (`othello-archive/src/steps/Explosion.tsx`, line 48).

evidence.quote: Keep the screen uncluttered. No two controls may do the same job.
They reject clutter, repeated content, AI-sounding copy, and two controls doing one job.
**Never render your own Next/Continue-to-next-step button.** The footer Next is the only forward control.
